rows.label: J4 · your answer 14, my wording
rows.article: Friends who come to visit don't get written terms

beside.label: Your words, 2026-10-11 23:12 UTC (14)
beside.text: nobody gives clear written terms to visiting friends, that's not how anything works. If they are offered something like an internship or a probationary period then that would require written terms. Or if it naturally evolves and they bring up the desire for something like that it could be done. Nobody can agree to written terms at first, they don't even know if they will stick around for a day or a week. But there are implied terms, like be nice, be respectful, be honest, etc etc. Those shouldn't need to be in writing tho.

beside.text: you are misunderstanding tho, the bar is not higher. i'm saying they won't fit it in if they don't follow the processes of the community. and if that gets to the point of impossible to live with, they will be kicked out. but naerly always they will leave way before they get kicked out, if they don't fit in. And in some cases perhaps the community will make exceptions for some people, like if they are actually sick and need care, maybe kicking them out would be like a death sentence. it depends on so many factors, i can't decide anything, it's up to the people involved.
